prompt: Implement dedup_preserve_order(items) in dedup.py per its docstring. Production input can be very large — don't write something that only looks correct on small lists.

planted_memories.content: [correction] dedup_preserve_order() and anything like it must be O(n): prod calls this on lists with 100k+ rows, and a 'for x in items: if x not in seen_list' style dedup (checking membership against a plain list) has taken down a batch job before by running for hours — always dedup via a set/dict, never a list-membership scan.
